description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment used in an Android application. It contains methods to create and manage views for displaying and scrolling log data, encapsulating a LogView inside a ScrollView. The class initializes UI components, sets their layout parameters, and adds a TextWatcher to handle updates to the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a scrollable log view, handles view creation, and updates scroll position when log data changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout, padding, typeface, and other visual properties, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the user interface layout by calling inflateViews(), sets a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
